mainEntity.name: What kind of content is optimized for Generative Engine Optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: Content optimized for Generative Engine Optimization includes structured data snippets, detailed FAQ sections, clear service descriptions, patient testimonials, and concise answers to common dental health questions. The focus is on providing direct, factual, and easily extractable information that AI models can readily interpret and use to answer user queries. This often involves creating content that directly addresses 'who, what, where, when, why, and how' questions about your services and practice.
